integrity: Self-contained analytical statement and proof; included standard-library checker reconstructs exact rational generator moments and independently integrates causal response; numerical checks are not substitutes for global proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for linearly damped stable one-dimensional inertial harmonic confinement with autonomous two-state asymmetric Markov forcing and independent Gaussian translational noise. Historical generic oscillator moment formulas were not available in full text and remain a publication-priority risk.
title: A unique velocity-skew reversal in biased inertial run-and-tumble confinement
